items.stem: Which TWO are true when analysing data with pandas inside Excel? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Data is loaded from ranges into a DataFrame for analysis
options.rationale: Correct: pandas operates on DataFrames created from Excel data.

options.text: The method chosen to fill missing values should be documented
options.rationale: Correct: imputation choices affect results and must be recorded.

options.text: A DataFrame is identical to an Excel named range
options.rationale: They are different objects with different behaviours.

options.text: Charts generated from Python need no review of their inputs
options.rationale: Outputs must still be validated against trustworthy inputs.

describe() summarises statistics, it does not join tables.
fillna handles missing values, not joins.
plot() visualises data; it does not join tables.
